scope: Synthetic SQLite governance/recovery fixtures and existing local upstream fixtures; no production operations or model/human experiment.

findings.description: A reviewer retaining high but losing critical authority could continue later members of a cumulative critical batch.

intermediate_fail_retained.description: An outer loop check still missed revocation before the member transaction.

findings.repair: Context-local aggregate critical requirement is revalidated together with individual action route using one current account snapshot inside AccessControl.require, used by both SQL and remote decisions; context resets in finally.

findings.description: Whitespace-only batch reason passed request validation then raised internal Decision validation and returned HTTP 500.
findings.repair: BatchDecision reuses Decision meaningful_reason validator, so invalid requests receive structured 422 before decisions.

positive_negative_controls: Cumulative route revoked between members and inside member decision
Same batch context stays in worker thread; independently reviewed high action still executes
Context restored after unexpected member exception
Whitespace and lone-surrogate batch reasons rejected before effect
Principal budgets persist over restart and expire without autoauthorization
Compensation of compensation requires a third independent approval
Trigger introduced after recovery preview blocks execution and releases reservation
limits: No linearizability claim against external reviewer-file modifications after the current member authorization snapshot; no distributed exactly-once claim.
No new functionality or outcome is claimed for human participants, representative business logs, real IdP or paid model calls.
